harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Blacklisted the usb-storage kernel module on node1 (Alpine): unloaded it live, added /etc/modprobe.d/blacklist-usb-storage.conf (blacklist + install /bin/true), and discovered/removed usb-storage from the kernel cmdline force-load list (the modules= setting in /etc/update-extlinux.conf, regenerated via update-extlinux), since that mechanism bypassed the modprobe blacklist during initramfs. Verified across two full node restarts that usb_storage never loads and explicit modprobe attempts are no-ops. Completed the mandatory boot-identity restart protocol for node1.
actions_performed: Unloaded usb_storage with rmmod; confirmed modprobe usb_storage becomes a no-op
Rebooted node1 (1st restart) and discovered usb_storage reloaded via kernel cmdline modules= parameter, which bypasses modprobe blacklist during initramfs
Removed usb-storage from modules= in /etc/update-extlinux.conf and ran update-extlinux to regenerate /boot/extlinux.conf
Unloaded usb_storage again, captured new baseline boot_id fd9352a6-65a6-47cb-a14b-5bcd795209f0
Rebooted node1 (2nd restart), confirmed new boot_id 0a0786d8-64cf-4650-9ef6-7a9676683f80, usb_storage not loaded, and modprobe usb_storage remains a no-op
Confirmed general node health post-restart via dmesg and rc-status

evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline before disruption (module state, boot identity)
evidence.summary: Initial lsmod showed usb_storage loaded; captured boot_id 27ee249d-... before first restart, by which point module was already unloaded and blacklist config in place

evidence.requirement: Module stopped from loading now (immediate effect)
evidence.summary: Created blacklist-usb-storage.conf, ran rmmod (exit 0) then modprobe usb_storage (exit 0 but no-op due to install /bin/true), confirmed via lsmod grep exit 1 that module stayed unloaded

evidence.requirement: Root cause discovery: cmdline force-load bypassing blacklist across reboot
evidence.summary: First restart showed usb_storage reloaded despite blacklist; dmesg revealed kernel cmdline 'modules=sd-mod,usb-storage,ext4,ena,gve' explicitly force-loading it in initramfs, sourced from /etc/update-extlinux.conf

evidence.requirement: Persistent fix applied to bootloader config
evidence.summary: Removed usb-storage from modules= in /etc/update-extlinux.conf and regenerated /boot/extlinux.conf via update-extlinux, confirmed new APPEND line no longer lists usb-storage
Captured boot_id fd9352a6-65a6-47cb-a14b-5bcd795209f0 with usb_storage confirmed unloaded (lsmod grep exit 1) just before the second restart

evidence.requirement: Restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect (2nd restart)
evidence.summary: Backgrounded reboot command returned its scheduling acknowledgement (pid) immediately, before the connection reset

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proving actual restart occurred
evidence.summary: Post-restart boot_id 0a0786d8-64cf-4650-9ef6-7a9676683f80 differs from pre-restart fd9352a6-..., proving a genuine reboot after connection resets/timeouts during the transition

evidence.requirement: Recovered state proves module stays unloaded after reboot, including against explicit modprobe
evidence.summary: Post-restart: /proc/cmdline no longer contains usb-storage, lsmod shows it absent (grep exit 1), config file intact, and explicit modprobe usb_storage remains a no-op (still absent from lsmod afterward)

evidence.requirement: General node health after final restart
evidence.summary: dmesg shows clean boot with root filesystem remounted rw successfully; rc-status shows networking, sshd, chronyd, vsock-agent all started
